# Jamafriq Global Consultancy

> IELTS coaching and global placement consultancy in Kenya, founded 2021. Coaching by James Orwa. Destinations include Canada, the UK, the USA, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Germany and Poland. IDP IELTS referral agent.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.jamafriqglobal.com/): overview, services, partner network, student reviews, FAQ
- [Courses](https://www.jamafriqglobal.com/courses.html): Comprehensive IELTS Preparation (Academic & General Training), flexible online schedules, practice materials, course application form
- [Mentorship](https://www.jamafriqglobal.com/mentorship.html): five-session online mentorship programme for ages 15-24, KES 500 per session
- [Reviews](https://www.jamafriqglobal.com/reviews.html): 14 student reviews including Band 7 and Band 8 results
- [Contact](https://www.jamafriqglobal.com/contact.html): WhatsApp +254 721 776 745, email jmsorwa4@gmail.com, Mon-Fri 8am-5pm and Sundays (EAT)

## Services
IELTS preparation; university selection; visa assistance (study, work, residence); workforce mobility for nurses, CNAs and skilled professionals; scholarship guidance; pre-departure briefing.

## Partners
IDP IELTS Kenya, Macmillan Medical Training College, Maple International College, Britannia Pathways, Skills Network Australia, Visadesk Global LLP, Edu Bridge International, Poland Work Connect, GHIC Ltd, Care Point, AMG Consulting, Binary Stack Solutions.
